scope: Read-only arithmetic on saved 12 bps accounting fixtures. No engine replay, parameter search, new fills, or fixture modification.

methodology.originalBooks: Three independently simulated 100000-dollar whole-share books. Original trades are retained under originalBooks.
methodology.combinedCurve: At each saved date: 0.25*base + 0.50*cooldown15 + 0.25*sector40 for cash/equity. Initial combined capital is 100000. No inter-sleeve rebalancing.
methodology.combinedTradeMetrics: Completed sleeve round trips counted without weighting; PnL and traded notional weighted 25/50/25. Analytical weighted units are not production-mapped or executable share quantities.
methodology.currentReplayDifference: Current replay uses actual 25000/50000/25000-dollar whole-share mappings; its terminal positions are marked, whereas these preserved frozen fixtures artificially liquidate at the final close.
methodology.reconstruction: Each saved sell fully closes one saved buy of the same symbol/sleeve. PnL=shares*(saved sell price-saved buy price); zero commissions; adverse cost already appears in saved fill prices. Holding sessions are differences in the unchanged saved curve index.
methodology.dailyStatistics: Uses current replay calculateMetrics: 252 annual sessions, zero risk-free rate, sample daily-return deviation for Sharpe. Standard Sortino uses zero-target downside RMS over all daily returns; legacySourceSortino uses sample deviation of negative daily returns. Median holding period selects the upper middle value.
methodology.savedPrecision: Equity and cash in original curve checkpoints are rounded to cents. Combined daily statistics use those preserved checkpoints; fill-price PnL reconstructs final equity within the original 0.0051-dollar accounting tolerance per 100000-dollar book.
methodology.turnover: Weighted sum of buy and sell notional divided by mean daily combined equity; annualized by 252/918.
methodology.utilization: Mean daily (1 - weighted cash / weighted equity).
methodology.unavailable: These fixtures do not contain benchmark histories, stop/exit reason metadata, forward holdout evidence, 25/50 bps trade ledgers, or the complete original ensemble profit-concentration receipt. Empty benchmarkComparisons means unavailable, not zero alpha.
